prose: Apple announced the $149 HomePod mini 2 with an S10 chip, 'Sound Glow' lighting and five colors; Siri AI, described as a more capable, conversational assistant with personal context, arrives in a future software update. Paired with the new Apple TV 4K it supports four-speaker surround sound.
highlights: HomePod mini 2: $149, S10 chip, five colors.
Siri AI arrives later via software update.
Works with the new Apple TV 4K for four-speaker surround.
